title: Compatibility with ggplot2 4.0.0
description:
Hi Barret, Sorry to bother with another issue! We've been preparing a new major release for ggplot2 and found an issue during a reverse dependency check. I tried mucking around in the code to find the source of the error, but I had a hard time figuring it out. It appears as if at some point duplicate parameters are passed to ggplot layers maybe? This is the error message that shows up: 

*   checking tests ... ERROR
    ```
      Running ‘testthat.R’
    Running the tests in ‘tests/testthat.R’ failed.
    Complete output:
      > library(testthat)
      > library(autocogs)
      > 
      > test_check("autocogs")
      [ FAIL 2 | WARN 1 | SKIP 0 | PASS 223 ]
      
      ══ Failed tests ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    ...
        8.         └─autocogs (local) FUN(X[[i]], ...)
        9.           └─base::lapply(...)
       10.             └─autocogs (local) FUN(X[[i]], ...)
       11.               ├─base::do.call(fn, args)
       12.               └─autocogs (local) ``(...)
       13.                 └─base::do.call(loess, c(core_params, params$method.args))
      
      [ FAIL 2 | WARN 1 | SKIP 0 | PASS 223 ]
      Error: Test failures
      Execution halted
    ```
You can test your code with the development version of ggplot2 by installing it as follows: ```r # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("tidyverse/ggplot2") ``` We aim to release the new ggplot2 version in about 2 weeks, and hope you can submit an update to CRAN around that time. Hopefully this will inform you in a timely manner. Best wishes, Teun

title: Issues with the next version of ggplot2
description:
Hi

We are preparing a new ggplot2 release that include bug fixes which unfortunately breaks some code in autocogs. The issue we have detected revolves around autocogs calling `compute_aesthetics` before `setup_layer()` has been called, e.g. here: 

https://github.com/schloerke/autocogs/blob/3f87c44fdc08410d708bb3610aa5c5f5d44c7b33/R/layer_info.R#L40

We plan to submit ggplot2 on May 31st and hope you'll be able to submit a fix before that
